DVV.soloNarrador: Only the Storyteller can do this.
DVV.sinActor: Pick a hunter: select their token or open their sheet first.
DVV.sinCelula: {actor} is not part of any Cell. Add them to a Cell sheet to use shared Desperation.

subir-danger-automatico.Name: Raise Danger automatically
subir-danger-automatico.Hint: When logging +1 Danger for using a power in front of a witness, also raise the Cell's Danger. By default it is only logged for the end of the session.

recordatorios-desesperacion.Name: Reminders after a 1 on Desperation dice
recordatorios-desesperacion.Hint: Posts the consequences to chat (Overreach or Despair; Silence, burnt Artifact or rejection crisis) when a roll with Desperation dice shows a 1.

tresPuertas.titulo: The Three Doors — Grant a path
tresPuertas.requiereModificado: Second Generation grafts require the Operation first.
tresPuertas.otorgado: {actor} walks through the door: {camino} ({rama}). Gains {pasiva} for free and the Flaw {defecto}.
tresPuertas.slotsExcedidos: This exceeds the Stamina limit ({limite}). It is not a purchase: it is a chronicle arc. Continue anyway?
tresPuertas.sinCaminos: {actor} has no path granted. Use “Grant a path” first.

desesperacion.quemado: {actor} — {gasto}: {motivo}. The Cell's Desperation drops from {antes} to {despues}.
desesperacion.peligroRegistrado: +1 Danger logged for the end of session: {actor}, {motivo}.
desesperacion.peligroAplicadoTodo: {n} Danger points applied to the Cell (now {valor}).

recordatorio.texto: {actor} rolled {unos} “1” on Desperation dice. On a win the player chooses: Overreach (+1 Danger per 1, keep the win) or Despair (fail and enter Despair). On a failure it is Despair, no choice.
recordatorio.camino: The roll was {poder} ({camino}). If it ends in Despair, also: {fallo}.

panel.sinCelula: There is no Cell sheet in the world. Create a Group → Cell actor and add the hunters.
panel.sinCazadores: No hunters with an assigned player.
panel.limpiarConfirmar: This clears the session Danger log. Continue?

importar.pregunta: This world does not have the chronicle yet. Import it now? It creates scenes, actors, journals and macros with their folders. You can do it later from the “Somnia Biotech — Importar la crónica” compendium or with the macro.
importar.sinAventura: The Adventure was not found in the module compendium.
